scripts.test:handoff: node --test tests/mixed-berry-source.test.mjs tests/package-size-serving.test.mjs tests/approved-website-copy.test.mjs tests/electrolyte-handoff.test.mjs tests/electrolyte-retirement.test.mjs tests/comparison-copy.test.mjs tests/one-pound-isolates.test.mjs tests/page-handoff.test.mjs
scripts.test:homepage: node scripts/check-browser-host.mjs && pnpm run test:homepage:parity && playwright test --config tests/homepage/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:supplements:browser: playwright test --config tests/homepage/playwright.config.ts supplement-purchase.spec.ts supplement-navigation.spec.ts supplement-filter-forced-colors.spec.ts
scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm run typecheck:homepage && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
